events.address: Astor Place Plaza, 26 Astor Place, New York, NY 10003
events.what_it_is: A two-day Reese's and The Nitro Bar coffee-truck pop-up debuting the Reese's Pumpkins PB Whip Latte at Astor Place Plaza.
events.what_is_free: Current listings advertise up to 1,000 complimentary Reese's Pumpkins PB Whip Lattes per day, with Reese's Pumpkins; the first 100 guests in line each day are advertised to receive a limited-edition Reese's × The Nitro Bar koozie.
events.caveats: Open to the public with no advance RSVP requirement published. Multiple current sources agree on September 14–15 and an 11 AM start. Availability is explicitly while supplies last; some secondary listings show a nominal 5 PM end, so the tracker does not promise that giveaways will remain available until 5 PM.
events.practical_notes: Monday and Tuesday, September 14–15 at Astor Place Plaza. Public access begins at 11 AM each day; arrive early because the latte, candy and first-100 koozie are supply-limited.

events.event_name: Step Up for Fashion on Madison Avenue
events.address: Madison Avenue, E 57th St to E 86th St, New York, NY
events.what_it_is: A public Madison Avenue fashion and philanthropy day with more than 50 participating retailers, in-store and sidewalk activations, fall-fashion presentations, hospitality, student-designer displays and shopping that benefits the CFDA Scholarship Fund.
events.what_is_free: The official Madison Avenue BID program advertises public sidewalk and in-store experiences including flowers, beverages, treats, surprises, refreshments and selected retailer-specific hospitality; individual merchandise and some perks remain purchase-based.
events.caveats: The official Madison Avenue BID page confirms the public program from 10 AM–6 PM on September 19. Retailer-specific offers vary: some are complimentary, some are while supplies last, and some gifts or benefits require a purchase. A separate Ivar Fine Jewelry activity lists an RSVP email, but that does not make the avenue-wide event RSVP-required.
events.practical_notes: Saturday, September 19 from 10 AM–6 PM along Madison Avenue and adjacent side streets between East 57th and East 86th Streets. Check the official BID page for the retailer-by-retailer activation list before choosing stops.
